title: scene-00: geoAnchor axes are left-handed
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:328 says +X East, +Y up, +Z North. East x Up = South, so this frame is left-handed, contradicting the right-handed convention at :129 and glTF. For right-handed Y-up, +Z must be South (North = -Z). Restate heading (:326) to match.
